name: tiny-push-utility
description: Desktop utility for setting up and managing remote access, installing packages, and collecting logs for Push 3 standalone.

scripts.setup: volta install node npm && npm ci
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/ssh-setup-webview-preload.js && node --check electron/devices.js && node --check electron/logs.js && node --check electron/network.js && node --check electron/ssh.js && node --check electron/tutorials.js
scripts.build:app: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --arm64
scripts.release:win: npm run dist:win && npm run artifacts:collect
scripts.release:win:x64: npm run dist:win:x64 && npm run artifacts:collect
scripts.release:win:arm64: npm run dist:win:arm64 && npm run artifacts:collect
scripts.release:mac: npm run dist:mac && npm run artifacts:collect
scripts.release:linux: npm run dist:linux && npm run artifacts:collect

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tiny Push Utility needs local network access to find and connect to Ableton Push devices.
